title: 어제 뭐 했어요? 하루 일과 이야기하기
objective: Say what you did yesterday in time order, using -기 전에 for what you did before another action.
summary: Two classmates talk about their day yesterday, using -기 전에 to put actions in order.
setting: Monday morning in a Korean classroom, before class starts.

task.title: TALK ABOUT YESTERDAY
task.line: Use the dialogue and -기 전에 to complete each task.

words.exampleMeaning: I get up at six every day.
I worked out with a friend yesterday.
I have a lot of homework today.
I read a book at the library.
I rested at home in the evening.

words.meaning: to sleep, to go to bed
words.exampleMeaning: I went to bed at twelve last night.

words.meaning: before (doing something). Add -기 전에 to the verb stem: 가다 → 가기 전에. Put the past tense only on the last verb.
words.exampleMeaning: I drink coffee before I go to school.

dialogue.meaning: Mark, what did you do yesterday?

dialogue.korean: 아침 일곱 시에 일어났어요. 그리고 공원에서 운동했어요.
dialogue.meaning: I got up at seven in the morning. Then I exercised in the park.
What did you do in the afternoon, Jisu?

dialogue.korean: 친구하고 영화를 봤어요. 영화를 보기 전에 같이 점심을 먹었어요.
dialogue.meaning: I saw a movie with a friend. Before the movie, we had lunch together.
In the afternoon, I did homework at the library.

dialogue.korean: 저녁을 먹고 한국 드라마를 봤어요. 그리고 자기 전에 샤워했어요.
dialogue.meaning: I ate dinner and watched a Korean drama. And before going to bed, I took a shower.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the right form of the verb in ( ): ①회사에 ____ 전에 아침을 먹었어요. (가다) ②친구를 ____ 전에 선물을 샀어요. (만나다)
Make one sentence with -기 전에. The first action comes first in time: ①손을 씻었어요 → 밥을 먹었어요 ②숙제를 했어요 → 게임을 했어요
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 걸었어요 / 일하기 전에 / 저는 / 공원에서
Answer in Korean, using the dialogue: ①지수 씨는 점심을 먹고 뭐 했어요? ②마크 씨는 오후에 어디에서 숙제를 했어요?
answers: ① 밥을 먹기 전에 손을 씻었어요. ② 게임을 하기 전에 숙제를 했어요.
저는 일하기 전에 공원에서 걸었어요. (Also correct: 일하기 전에 저는 공원에서 걸었어요.)
① 친구하고 영화를 봤어요. (Also correct: 영화를 봤어요.) ② 도서관에서 숙제를 했어요. (Also correct: 도서관에서 했어요.)
